en: Black-and-white postcard depicting a pavilion complex with arched colonnades in the foreground and a tall tower with a dome-like building in the background. The architecture is in a North African / Islamic style, shown as part of a colonial exhibition. A person is walking in the courtyard. Printed French captions describe it as a view of the Algerian pavilion from the official Tunisian pavilion at the Exposition Coloniale Internationale in Paris, 1931.
